title: Interesting historical site & great guide
text: Joanna gave us an excellent tour of this very interesting site, making the lives of the Roman residents come to life. The mosaics in the homes at this site are amazing, and the remaining wall foundations make the housing area easy to visualize. The amphitheater is what remains of the 3rd largest Roman one. We actually enjoyed visiting it more than the one in Rome because there were no crowds. My husband uses a hiking pole for stability on uneven surfaces, but he was able to manage this site & Joanna was very understanding of his needs & helpful. We took a taxi from our hotel in the Barrio Sant
author: 12josie

title: Great tour
text: David was very polite and knowledgeable.  Even helped us get back into the city.  He’s also a photographer, so we got great photos! We enjoyed our tour. Thank you
author: Meg_P

title: Great Roman Ruins with a super guide
text: Joanna gave us a great tour of Italica. She was very knowledgeable and the site was impressive.  The little museum was also interesting.  Totally worth the 20 minute drive from Seville if you are into Roman ruins
author: 797susano

title: Worth your time
text: Alexis was very knowledgeable and funny. We had a great time talking about Italica and Spanish history. We almost had the place to ourselves which was fun but we didn’t understand why because the ruins were amazing. We also loved it as Game of Thrones fans because they filmed there!
author: sumdog99

title: Great tour!
text: Carmen was a fabulous guide. She was so knowledgeable about the history of Italica and Roman Empire history in general. We learned a lot from her and had so much fun. She was friendly and punctual and an all around delight. Definitely would recommend this tour!
author: mholden

title: Italica-must see if have any interest in Roman era
text: Was a fantastic tour. Very, very informative. Alex was a walking encyclopedia re Italica and Roman outposts in general. Is a nice pace as walk the streets in place over 1000 years and see the remnants of the portion of the city escalated to date. Is an active archaeological site so every year more is uncovered and restored!
author: lylep2018

title: Alex was amazing!
text: The tour of Italica was interesting and Alex was informative. He was on time and obviously knew the history and layout of this Roman treasure. The weather was not ideal yet the two hours flew by as if was a more pleasant sunny day. Highly recommend Alex and Italica!!
author: Lyle_P

title: Phenomenal
text: This tour was really phenomenal! And our guide Javier was great! Javier was personable, professional as well as extremely knowledgeable about everything this tour had to offer.  We really enjoyed seeing this interesting & historic landmark and learning all about it. We would highly recommend!
author: Neil R

title: Fascinating tour of Roman ruins (and Game Of Thrones set) with an Excellent tour guide!
text:
We heard that there's a historic part of Sevilla that was used for filming Game of Thrones, and decided to go see.
We booked this tour to ensure we learned the history of Sevilla, and some modern info as well.

Thanks to our guide, we enjoyed the tour and learned a lot as well.

Our guide was easy to understand (we speak English and just a little Spanish) and a very nice guy.
He obviously knows the history of Sevilla well, he even has a college degree in history.
Our guide made the tour so interesting, that we forgot about the weather (hot!) and took lots of
pictures.  
And he was nice enough
author: William_P

title: Italian
text:
Our visit to Italica has been 10. a walk of more than 2 hours with a sunny day and everything very nice. Javi, our guide has explained everything to us perfectly, in all detail and taste. His architectural studies denote the love he feels towards this type of historical construction and has given us a real class.
Experience with rating of 10 and recommended for everyone.
author: andresfdezleal
